question: Can the AI Storyteller's failure, limit and redirect moments play in the cast's live voices with no network, so a failure is a performance and never silence?
why: Lane D, finish sprint (docs/plans/2026-11-15-finish-ai-storyteller.md, stages 1 and 2): every failure gets an in-story outcome, and the app owns the ending even when the AI or the voices are down. These lines are played from the headset, so they can't be voiced live.
sameAcrossJobs: ElevenLabs text to speech directly (not Runway), with art/voice/live.json's model (eleven_flash_v2_5), voice ids and settings, so they match the live lines exactly. mp3, levelled like run 010 into art/sound/storyteller/.
decideBy: Each clip decodes, is levelled, and is under 6 s.
The owner hears them on the Quest's speakers in headset session B, beside live lines from the same voices.
learnEvenIfRejected: Whether eleven_flash_v2_5 holds a character's voice the same across a prepared line and a live one, which any later prepared Storyteller line depends on.
reusableOutput: art/sound/storyteller/: the Storyteller's recorded lines, played by id from client/src/storyteller/ for each failure outcome.
estimateNote: 712 characters with ElevenLabs on the existing account, well under $1. No Runway credits: lane D's 40-credit budget is untouched.
capNote: Covers a second take of every line.
status: planned; waiting for the sprint master's approval before any spend
